q: Do paint solvents in a car body shop count in its carbon footprint?
title: Body shops: paint solvents and carbon
short: The solvents themselves are mostly volatile organic compounds, an air quality issue rather than a greenhouse gas line. What counts is the paint and solvent you buy, as Scope 3 purchased goods, and the gas or diesel for the booth's heaters, as Scope 1.
audience: Car body shops and accident repair workshops

p: Booth fans and compressors as Scope 2.
Paint, primer and thinner bought as Scope 3 category 1.
Do not add solvent VOC emissions to a CO2e total unless your method converts them; most small workshop reports do not.

senseible: Senseible reads electricity bills (CEA grid factor 0.710 kg CO2 per kWh, CO2 Baseline Database version 21.0) and diesel, LPG and gas invoices (IPCC 2006 defaults) into a dated, fingerprinted Scope 1 and 2 record for each site. Intensity per unit uses the activity count you enter, and estimates are labelled as estimates.
